name: NYC Open Data (Socrata SODA)
summary: Free SODA REST API over NYC Open Data: crashes, 311 requests, restaurant inspections, arrests, ridership, vital records and about 2,400 other city datasets.
description: data.cityofnewyork.us is a Socrata portal. Each dataset is a table with a 4x4 id queryable at /resource/{id}.json using SoQL ($select, $where, $group, $order, $limit, $offset, $q). The Discovery API at /api/catalog/v1 searches the portal. Popular data.gov entries served from this host include Motor Vehicle Collisions - Crashes (h9gi-nx95), 311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present (erm2-nwe9), DOHMH Restaurant Inspection Results (43nn-pn8j) and NYPD Arrest Data (uip8-fykc).

auth.notes: Works without credentials; an optional free Socrata app token gives a per-application throttling pool instead of the shared per-IP pool.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limit documented. Without an app token requests share a per-IP pool and can be throttled with HTTP 429.

endpoints.summary: Discovery API: search datasets on the portal
Dataset metadata: columns, license, update time

license.name: Varies per dataset; the crashes dataset has no license field in its metadata. See the NYC terms of use.

agent_notes: Find ids via /api/catalog/v1?domains=data.cityofnewyork.us&q=<topic>&only=datasets. Values are strings; cast in SoQL. The X-SODA2-Fields header lists columns. Add $order for stable paging. Dates are floating timestamps without a zone.
caveats: Numeric columns are returned as JSON strings.

In the research sandbox the host's certificate chain (GlobalSign R46) was not trusted, so curl needed -k; the API itself answered 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Re-verify on a machine with a current CA store.
Updates vary per dataset; the crashes table was last modified the day it was checked.

verification.notes: Request executed without an app token using curl -k because of the sandbox trust store; catalog size 2410 datasets at check.
